name: angent
description: ANGENT cognitive layer and portable Engineer capabilities in one agent plugin.

interface.longDescription: ANGENT combines evidence-grounded reasoning, coherent authoring, authorized execution, quality and continuity with a bundled 103-Skill portable Engineer catalog in one plugin. Native AgentKit Engineer remains preferred when actually usable.
defaultPrompt: Use ANGENT to distinguish the actual need, requested means, evidence and value, without overriding binding constraints.
Answer early; orient substantive replies to decisive reasoning; close with a useful synthesis, not repetition.
For consequential work, verify outcomes, respect approval boundaries and report meaningful uncertainty.
